text:
tara: Heads-up I found a misleading snippet in the Console "observability" guide under the cost breakdown section. The promql example shows cpu metric usage for per-token cost, but on Dedicated we emit gpu_seconds_total. That mismatch will trip up infra folks trying to reconcile billing vs dashboard.

ben: thanks for flagging. can you paste the exact snippet so i don't hunt through the page?

tara: sure — current doc shows:
```promql
rate(cpu_seconds_total{job=\"inference\"}[5m]) / sum(rate(tokens_generated[5m]))
```

nina: that should definitely be gpu_seconds_total for Dedicated. for Hosted we surface an aggregated metric (hosted_compute_seconds) that maps back to our multi-tenant accounting. we need a short paragraph explaining which metric to use depending on deployment.

ben: i can open a micro-PR: replace cpu_seconds_total with gpu_seconds_total, add a note about hosted vs dedicated metric names, and update the JS SDK snippet that still uses the old field name `token_count`.

docs-bot: Suggested PR template: small-fix -> docs -> include changelog entry if user-facing.

alexa: also call out aggregation window. the current example implicitly uses a 5m window; that's fine but readers compare p50 latencies with cost which are sensitive to window size and workload. maybe add a short sentence: "For bursty workloads, increase window to 1m or 15m as needed."

ira: i recommend adding a "what to watch for" bullet: "If cost per token spikes while p50 is stable but p95 increases, check batch_size and KV cache hit-rate." link to issue #342 for batch-size tail latency analysis.

ben: good idea. i'll include a short reproducible command folks can run against their Prometheus:
```
# check per-token cost (dedicated)
rate(gpu_seconds_total{job=\"inference\"}[5m]) / sum(rate(tokens[5m]))
```

ben: plan for the patch: 1) PR to swap metric + add hosted note + add aggregation sentence 2) update dashboard JSON in repo/dashboards/cost-breakdown.json if needed (i'll open a companion PR) 3) docs reviewer sanity check 4) merge + changelog entry. target: today.

deploy-bot: New PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/601 title: "fix(obsv): correct per-token metric + clarify aggregation windows"

nina: i'll review later today. small ask: include an example number to help non-infra readers grasp typical delta between cpu- and gpu-accounting (e.g., cpu-based accounting undercounts GPU time by ~0.02s/token for 512-token median on g4dn). put that as an illustrative example with a caveat.

ben: will add a 2-row example table and label it "illustrative only".

tara: thanks. once merged i'll re-run the quickstart that generates the sample dashboard to confirm the widget labels and legend match the doc.

ira: ping me for the review, happy to check wording and the "known caveats" bullet.

ben: merging after reviews. i'll update the thread with the merged PR link.

nina: top-level note for release notes: this is a docs-only fix but may surface to customers so we should include a one-line blurb in next release: "docs: clarify cost metric names for Hosted vs Dedicated".

tara: perfect, thanks all.
